_comment: Permission rules gateway expects in your user settings.json. `pixi run install` merges them for you; {PLUGIN_DIR} becomes the plugin's path. The 'ask' rules are what make Claude Code prompt for port_check, for root commands when sudo is disabled, and for git_confirm/gh_confirm (calls an account's policy says to ask about), so keep them. Read(~/.config/age/**), Read(~/.config/secrets/**) and Bash(secret:*) protect a personal age-based secret store if you have one; harmless otherwise.
